title: Complementing DINO Features with Image Structure for Part Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.32293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) like DINO encode rich semantics, enabling training-free segmentation of objects from the background and discovery of their parts via feature clustering. This paper focuses on part discovery: partitioning a foreground object into semantic parts. Existing approaches produce imprecise part boundaries. We trace this to the rigid ViT patch grid used in training DINO, where patches straddling boundaries contain pixels from multiple parts. While DINO's invariance-based training could absorb this pixel-level mixing into clean features, experiments with over 26K foreground patches show it does not: boundary-overlapping patches produce features with higher entropy and lower assignment confidence, blurring predicted part boundaries. translated_title: 结合图像结构补充DINO特征以实现部件发现
translated_abstract: 诸如DINO之类的自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）编码了丰富的语义信息，使得无需训练即可将物体从背景中分割出来，并通过特征聚类发现物体的部件。本文聚焦于部件发现任务：将前景物体划分为若干语义部件。现有方法产生的部件边界不够精确。我们将这一问题追溯到训练DINO时使用的刚性ViT补丁网格：跨越边界的补丁会包含来自多个部件的像素。虽然DINO基于不变性的训练本可以将这种像素级混合吸收为干净的特征，但通过对超过26K个前景补丁的实验表明事实并非如此：与边界重叠的补丁会产生熵更高、分配置信度更低的特征，从而使预测的部件边界变得模糊。与其投入巨大精力在几何连贯的区域上重新训练DINO，一种更简单的方案是直接从边界检测器获取边界信息……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了基于DINO特征的部件发现边界模糊的根源在于ViT刚性补丁网格导致跨边界补丁混合了多个部件的像素，并提出用图像结构（来自边界检测器的边界信息）补充DINO特征，从而在无需重新训练的情况下实现更精确的部件发现。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that blurry part boundaries in DINO-based part discovery stem from the rigid ViT patch grid mixing pixels across part boundaries, and proposes complementing DINO features with image structure from a boundary detector to achieve precise part discovery without retraining.
